notes.title: Threshold Sector is out NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]After much time and effort I'm happy to finally be able to release [b]Threshold Sector[/b] in its complete version![/h2]

[h3]But what exactly is new in this version?[/h3]
Much has changed and much has been added, here is a general overview:

[list]
[*]The game now features a complete storyline you can follow by completing the various randomly generated "Expeditions". 
These will take you through all the challenges of the Sector, in an increasingly difficult journey to try and escape the complex.

[*]You'll be able to take a break between your Expeditions in your very own Hideout.
This is a safe area you can upgrade to improve your chances of survival in the Sector.
Improving the Hideout requires materials: these are scattered throughout the levels, and you'll need to extract to be able to bring them back home.

[*]There have been multiple quality of life improvements, difficulty tweaking and slight feature reworks that should make for a better experience overall.

[*]Lastly, there is also some new content in terms of threats and self defence, but I'll leave this as a "surprise" of sort.
[/list]
[h3]What about the Demo version?[/h3]
The Demo received an update as well. You can currently play the first expedition with all the new features, updates and improvements.
This implies of course some limitations: you won't be able to continue the story or get to your Hideout.

[h3]So what now?[/h3]
It's been a tough and rewarding journey, but it's not over yet: I'm committed to follow this first release with the necessary care and make the game as stable as I possibly can with the time and resources I have.

Together with that, I've already started work on some new content and minor features, which unfortunately is definitely going to take some time and won't be implemented in the near future.
I'll try to share updates if/when I can.

[h3]That said,[/h3]
a huge THANK YOU to everyone who played the Demo, posted feedback or even just followed along with interest, it really is a great source of motivation!
I hope you'll enjoy the full version, cheers and see you in the Sector!

notes.title: Demo 2 is out NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]DEMO 2 has released![/h3]
It only took a little more than I expected, so that's kinda neat!

Some of the things you can look forward to this new Demo version:
[list]
[*] New enemy: [b][strike]REDACTED[/strike][/b]
[*] New enemy: [b][strike]REDACTED[/strike][/b]
[*] New weapon: Full auto carabine
[*] New weapon: Heavy pistol
[*] New weapon attachments
[*] New feature: In-game tutorial
[*] New feature: Procedural levels
[*] New feature: Lockpicking
[*] New feature: Ladders
[*] New post processing and lighting, with improved real time shadows
[*] New volumetric effects
[*] New WIP loot scattering system

And more!
[/list]

Most of the development time was spent creating the procedural generation system and building tools to make the whole development process quicker. That (and real life) affected the amount of content available in the demo, especially in terms of the variety of the new procedural levels.
However, the new tools will lead to less trouble developing more content and systems, and an overall faster delivery of the full version of the game!

As always expect bugs, glitches and crashes, and don't hold back expressing your thoughts, concerns and ideas in the community section!

Speaking of bugs, here are some of the known issues I'm still fighting against:
[list]
[*] Some items might show a different name when picking them up
[*] UI scaling is still WIP
[*] Procedural generation can rarely lead to crashes at the beginning of the level
[*] Enemies can very rarely cause crashes when aggroed
[/list]

That's it from me, but I will probably push some minor content patches and hotfixes in the following days and weeks

[b]Have fun in the Sector![/b]
